## Intent — what this is for

Optional live-view (PiP) mirroring screenshots the model already read, and an optional cursor-motion overlay that draws a fake cursor (invisible to screen capture) so a watching human sees where a click will land, plus a dashboard view (§3.7). Both are observation-only and grant the agent nothing.

## Done when

The views render; neither adds any agent capability — asserted by confirming the tool surface is unchanged with the views on; validated.

**Notes:** A human-facing view of an agent driving the desktop is the right thing to build and the easiest thing to make lie. Pinning refused-paints-nothing beside failed-paints-the-attempt is what makes the overlay evidence rather than decoration.
